answer: An answer must include the first 24 hex characters of the seed it was derived under, and a wrong or missing derivation is rejected at intake. Because the ember derivation is checked against the forge nonce, the anchor audit keeps the accepted values and a reused text fails on the first character. That binds the text to one identity's challenge, so copying between 165 aliases produces 165 mismatches and forfeits the authoring cost with no payout. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
